en.html:
A moment of possession, perhaps. That thought had risen like a bank of clouds and filled my chest. I hurriedly shook it off.

No. I must not.
The right to interfere in this world's affairs belonged to the beings of this world.

I was an outsider. Given one extraordinary chance to peep inside, bas. That did not give me permission to meddle.

If my decisions and actions were to change anything, it had to be what happened in MY world...

ja.html:
<ruby>魔<rt>・</rt></ruby>が差したとでも云うべきか。
　不意に群雲の如く湧いて胸中を満たしたその考えを、
俺は慌てて振り払った。

　ならぬ。
　この世界の事象に干渉を許されるのは、この世界の
存在のみ。

　俺は部外者であり、稀有な機会を得て覗き見ている
に過ぎない。
　手を出す資格などない。

　俺の決断そして行動によって変えられるものがある
とすれば、それは俺自身の世界の事象だけなのだ……。

en.html:
I did not look at the girl again. Look, and who knew what thoughts would come back?

I concentrated on the corrective force and let it take me.

...Could we return to our own time and place now? Soon, at least?
